name: retro-barbie-pink-portrait
image_purpose: vintage fashion lookbook and editorial cover portrait

prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic cinematic 1960s Barbiecore fashion portrait using the approved adult reference while preserving facial structure, natural skin tone, and original silhouette.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with natural facial structure and skin tone, soft confident smile, pink rollers in voluminous curls, pearl earrings, and a bubblegum-pink satin off-shoulder mini dress with puff sleeves. She sits in a powder-pink velvet chair holding a vintage white-and-gold telephone receiver near her face.
composition_elements: Vertical 2:3 tight bust-up portrait with a slightly low angle.
Bright solid pink studio background and powder-pink velvet chair.
One hand rests near the collarbone; the other holds the vintage telephone.
Monochromatic bubblegum and powder pink palette with white and gold accents.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: High-key soft warm beauty lighting, gentle highlights on satin and natural skin, subtle dimensional shadows, glossy polished cinematic finish.
prompt.technical_specs: 85mm portrait lens, photorealistic pores and fabric texture, no plastic smoothing, vertical 2:3, no text or watermark.
